title: New START treaty to reduce nuclear weapons

tellings.quote: The salt I think was uh no it's called a new start treaty when President Obama was in office actually signed a treaty with Russia to reduce the number of operational weapon nuclear weapons.

plain: Robert Salas, a former US Air Force officer who looked after nuclear missiles, describes the New START treaty, an agreement signed by President Barack Obama with Russia around 2010. Salas says the treaty cut the number of nuclear weapons each side keeps ready to use. He brings it up as background to his account of UFOs interfering with nuclear missiles, where the fate of these weapons is the heart of the story.
